showActivityValuesText.description: Change, if the activity values text should be shown in the process nodes.

barColor.description: Change the color of the progress bar in the activity.

breakAfterEveryXWord.description: Change, if the activity name should have line breaks after every xth word.

showActivityIcons.description: Change, if the activity icon should be shown in the process nodes.

activityIconPosition.description: Change the position of the activity icon.

activityIconSize.description: Change the size of the activity icon.

show.description: Change, if the target process should be used and shown in the process graph.

showFullTargetProcess.description: Change, if the unfiltered target process should be shown.

useColorForEvents.description: Change, if the nodes should be colored.

colorIncluding.description: Change the color of the target process in the graph.

colorExcludingAutomatic.description: Change, if the color of deviations should be automatic.

colorExcluding.description: Change the color of the deviating target process in the graph.

activityLegendSettings.description: Format settings to modify look and feel of the activity legend.

highlightFullActivity.description: Select wether to highlight the full node or only the border.

borderWidth.description: Change the border width of nodes when using activity legend values.

showLegend.description: Select if the legend should be shown in the visual or not.

position.description: Select the location for the legend.

showTitle.description: Display a title for legend symbols.

enumeration.value: "Segoe UI Bold", wf_segoe-ui_bold, helvetica, arial, sans-serif
"Segoe UI Light", wf_segoe-ui_bold, helvetica, arial, sans-serif

durationSettings.description: Format settings to modify look and feel of the duration labels.

labelUnits.description: Select the duration unit you want to use.

labelRound.description: Select wether to round the values used directly on the transitions.

labelMaxDecimalPoints.description: Change the number of maximum shown decimal points for values directly on the transitions.

tooltipUnits.description: Select the duration unit you want to use.

tooltipRound.description: Select wether to round the values used within the tooltips.

tooltipMaxDecimalPoints.description: Change the number of maximum shown decimal points for values within the tooltips.

show.description: Change, if you want to show the swim lanes.

marginBetweenBoxes.description: Change the margin between the swim lanes

borderRadius.description: Change the border radius of the swim lanes

fillColor.description: Change the color of the swim lane.

fillOpacity.description: Change the opacity of the fill color.

strokeColor.description: Change the color of the swim lane stroke.

strokeWidth.description: Change the width of the swim lane stroke.

labelPosition.description: Select the location for the labels.

fontColor.description: Change the color of the swim lane font.

fontFamily.description: Specify font family for swim lanes.

enumeration.value: "Segoe UI Bold", wf_segoe-ui_bold, helvetica, arial, sans-serif
"Segoe UI Light", wf_segoe-ui_bold, helvetica, arial, sans-serif

fontSize.description: Specify font size for swim lanes.

showNavigator.description: Change, if you want to show the navigator.

useSmallMenuItems.description: Change, if you want to use the small menu items rather than the normal ones.

menuColor.description: Change the color of menu items.

defaultTopVariantsPercentage.description: Define the percentage of initially shown cases.

mostFrequent.description: Show the most frequent top X variants, or least frequent X variants. X is defined in the initially shown variants field above.

aboutSettings.description: Information related to Process Analyzer such as version and license.

version.description: Version of the Process Analyzer you are using.

processScienceLicenseKey.description: Provide your license key or integrate it in the Theme.json file.
